summary: Upload a file (raw Frappe endpoint)
description: Standard Frappe multipart file upload -- returns a file_url that most agency_tracking parsing endpoints (parse_contract_file, parse_passport_file, upload_contract, etc.) expect as their file_url argument.

summary: Log in (raw Frappe endpoint)
description: Standard Frappe session-cookie login. Not an agency_tracking function -- Frappe's own built-in auth endpoint, listed here because it's the first call any frontend makes.

summary: Log out
description: Ends the current session cookie.

summary: Get current session user
description: allow_guest=True so a page refresh doesn't 403 before the SPA even knows whether a session exists. Returns null for Guest, otherwise user/full_name/roles.

summary: Get CSRF token
description: Frappe requires this token on every state-changing request once logged in.

summary: Cancel an Applicant (global escape hatch)
description: Only from Registered/CV Generated. If an active_placement exists, freezes it and every linked Clearance Step to Cancelled first, then cancels the Applicant itself. Never bumps cycle_number by itself -- only a later restart does.

summary: Open a new Applicant file at Draft
description: Draft floor: full_name, gender, nationality, entry_track. Accepts any other Applicant field as additional form data.

summary: Fetch a single Applicant
description: Full doc as dict.

summary: List Applicants the caller's role can read
description: backend-issues #02: whitelisted replacement for the raw /api/resource/Applicant fallback. Enforces the doctype's own permissions (Registrar, Manager, Admin, System Manager, Finance Manager, Clearance Officer, Complaint Manager, Communication Manager, and the six country+step roles).

summary: Set a permanent per-(Applicant, Country) ban
description: backend-issues #08: previously no whitelisted writer existed for Applicant Country Ban -- the doctype's own permissions already grant create to Registrar/Complaint Manager/Manager/Admin/System Manager.

summary: List country bans, optionally scoped to one Applicant
Lift a country ban
description: Delete permission on Applicant Country Ban is Manager/Admin/System Manager only -- Registrar/Complaint Manager can set a ban but not lift one.

summary: Manually log the Registration Fee to the Finance ledger
description: Sets fee_status=Paid and saves -- Applicant.maybe_log_fee_transaction then creates the actual Pending Applicant Transaction in the same save. Requires fee_required + registration_fee_amount already set; throws if this fee was already logged.

summary: Draft -> Registered
description: Field-floor and medical checks run inside Applicant.validate(), triggered by the sanctioned transition() path.

summary: Restart a Cancelled Applicant
description: Cancelled -> Draft or Registered. cycle_number bumps automatically. Restarting straight to Registered fails naturally if the field floor isn't actually satisfied.

summary: Edit an Applicant at Draft or Registered
description: Does not change status -- use register_applicant for that. If entry_track changes while Registered/CV Generated, forces a regression to Draft first (cycle_number bumps automatically). destination_country changes are checked against Applicant Country Ban.

summary: LMIS-stage edit: national_id, labor_id, emergency contact, COC
description: Narrow allowlisted edit surface -- national_id/labor_id/emergency_contact_*/coc_status/exam_date are deliberately NOT part of the Registered field floor; they're captured here once the candidate is actually at the LMIS clearance step. Any field outside the allowlist is silently ignored.

summary: List which officer is currently assigned to each Clearance Step on a Placement
description: Sourced from the same open ToDo assignment data that drives Clearance Step permissions -- every Placement detail view exposes who's currently working each step.

summary: Add a participant to an internal thread
description: Agency threads are fixed at exactly two participants -- blocked outright for those.

summary: Create/get this agency's thread with the Communication Manager
description: Foreign Agency only. No recipient parameter -- routing happens entirely server-side.

summary: Create/get an internal staff-to-staff thread
description: Internal staff only, open between all staff, no role restriction. Never a route into an agency's thread.

summary: Get all messages in a thread
List the current user's threads
Mark a thread as read for the current user
Send a message in a thread
description: Must have text or an attachment. Mentioning an Applicant/Placement still requires read permission on the mentioned record.

summary: Mark a Clearance Step complete/Issued
description: Not for Embassy steps. LMIS (both countries) completes to 'Issued'; everything else (Taeshir, Telesign) completes to the generic 'Complete'. Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).

summary: List the current user's Clearance Step queue
description: A Clearance Officer/Ticketer's own ToDo-scoped queue, or -- for the six country+step roles -- every row of their matching step_type.

summary: Reassign a Clearance Step to a different officer
description: The escape hatch for the default auto-chain assignment. Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).

summary: Mark an Embassy step Rejected (Thursday, failure outcome)
description: Saudi/Kuwait Embassy only. A written rejection_remark is required. Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).

summary: Mark an Embassy step Stamped (Thursday, success outcome)
description: Saudi/Kuwait Embassy only. Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).

summary: Mark a Clearance Step In Progress
description: Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).

summary: Submit an Embassy step's documents (Monday)
description: Saudi/Kuwait Embassy only. Pending -> Submitted. Blocked (417) once the step is already terminal (Issued/Complete/Stamped/Rejected) or its parent Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-3).

summary: New -> Unresolved
Log a complaint against a placed worker
description: A Foreign Agency can only complain about their own placement; internal staff need a recognized staff role.

summary: List Unresolved complaints, oldest-first
description: So nothing quietly sits forgotten at the bottom of a list.

summary: Resolve a complaint (Resolved / Free Replacement / Escalated / Dismissed)
description: Dismissed requires a written resolution_notes. override_reason (Manager Override) widens permission to include plain Manager for that one call.

summary: Generate and attach the official Agency CV PDF
description: Standard track, Registered status only. Renders via a Frappe Print Format, mirrors to Cloudflare R2 (falls back to a local private file if Storage Settings isn't configured). Moves the Applicant to CV Generated.

summary: Approve a Pending transaction
description: Pending -> Approved via the sanctioned transition() path. Only Approved entries count toward ledger/balance totals.

summary: Batch a contractor's owed commissions for settlement
Get the cached FX rate for a currency
description: ETB is hardcoded to 1.0 (Birr itself, no conversion needed). Other currencies fall back to the most recent cached rate on or before as_of_date; throws if none was ever recorded.

summary: List a contractor's owed (unbatched, Approved) commissions
Log an expense
description: Open to any internal staff role -- Finance Manager/Admin approval (approve_transaction) is the real gate, not who's allowed to log. placement is optional (general office expenses are loggable too).

summary: Log income
description: Same shape/permissions as log_stage_expense.

summary: Reject a Pending transaction
description: Pending -> Rejected. A written rejection_reason is required.

summary: Manually record an FX rate
description: Custom-mode path (FX Rate Settings). ETB cannot be set -- it's always 1:1, hardcoded.

summary: Mark specific Commission Batch Items paid (partial settlement)
description: AGREED_SPEC.md Part 7.3 (backend-issues #09): explicit multi-select manual settlement, alongside upload_batch_payment_proof's parser. Batch status becomes Partially Settled until every item is Paid.

summary: Upload a paid-applicants list (CSV or PDF) and fuzzy-match against a batch
description: AGREED_SPEC.md Part 7.3 (backend-issues #09): best-effort parse + fuzzy name match against the batch's own item list. Unmatched names stay Pending for manual settle_batch_items review -- never blocks.

summary: Render a Commission Batch invoice PDF on demand
description: AGREED_SPEC.md Part 7.3 (backend-issues #09): applicant names + amounts, built fresh whenever requested, not pre-generated/stored at batch creation.

summary: Mark a Commission Batch settled
Manually trigger commission accrual early
description: For cases needing to bill sooner than Departed. Idempotency-guarded -- calling this then later reaching Departed naturally is a no-op the second time.

summary: Void an Approved transaction
description: Approved -> Voided, via transition(). No hard delete, ever -- the row stays visible with its status flagged. A written void_reason is required.

summary: Register a new foreign agency and its portal login
description: backend-issues #07: Contractor.user is a required, unique Link, so there was previously no whitelisted way to create one -- Muayena placement creation (create_muayena_placement's contractor_name) is unusable without a Contractor to point at.

summary: List Contractors the caller's role can manage
description: backend-issues #07: read surface for picking an existing agency (create_muayena_placement's contractor_name, Finance's batching/rate lookups).

summary: List unpaid Wakala-bearing Embassy steps for the agency's own placements
Browse the candidate catalog
description: Standard-track, CV Generated, not yet locked by anyone, matching the agency's own destination country. Non-PII fields only.

summary: Select a candidate (creates a Placement)
description: Atomic, globally exclusive -- row-locked so two concurrent selections can't both succeed. free_replacement_for_complaint uses an approved free-replacement credit instead of billing normally.

summary: Check whether the current user has an active Push Subscription
description: Drives the manual 'enable notifications' fallback button.

summary: Subscribe the current browser to Push notifications
description: A user subscribing their own browser -- never on behalf of anyone else.

summary: Manually trigger a Wakala payment reminder
description: The escape hatch alongside the automatic Fri/Sat/Sun watchdog. Embassy steps only.

summary: Extract structured fields from an uploaded contract
description: Saudi: contract#/visa#/employer/agency/salary. Kuwait: employer/site/duration/salary only (its template carries far less). Returns mock fixture data instead of real OCR when Document Parsing Settings.use_mock_parsing is on.

summary: Extract fields from a Saudi Injaz paper
description: Injaz application number, passport number, applicant demographics, origin agency.

summary: Extract fields from a Kuwait eVisa document
description: visa_number/type/dates/reference, sponsor name+civil ID, Kuwait agency name+license.

summary: Extract MRZ fields from a passport scan
description: ICAO 9303 checksum self-correcting MRZ parser (TD3/TD1), falls back to visual OCR. Never raises -- returns {} on failure.

summary: Move a Placement forward via the sanctioned transition() path
description: The direct/manual advance. override_reason attempts a Manager Override if the move is gate-blocked.

summary: Create a Placement directly (Muayena track)
description: Muayena enters directly at Selected with contract in hand -- no portal, no CV. Contractor is always picked manually.

summary: Record a ticket reschedule
description: reschedule_cost only meaningful/loggable when cause=Internal -- an airline/airport-caused reschedule isn't billed to the agency. Blocked (417) once the Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-1).

summary: Record the post-contract medical result
description: Gates Selected -> Processing. FIT just records the result; UNFIT cancels the whole Applicant + Placement via the same cascade as cancel_applicant. Blocked (417) once the Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-1).

summary: Record the pre-departure (Medical 2) result
description: Gates Ticketed -> Departed. FIT just records the result; UNFIT cancels the whole Applicant + Placement via the same cascade as cancel_applicant. Blocked (417) once the Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-1).

summary: Record ticket number/flight date, auto-logs cost as an expense
description: ticket_cost (if given) auto-creates a Pending Applicant Transaction expense. Blocked (417) once the Placement is already Departed/Cancelled (cc2 QA pass, backend-issues NEW-1).

summary: Attach a signed contract to a Selected Placement
description: Extracts contract_signed_date plus country-specific structured fields via contract_parser.parse_contract_file.

summary: Attach a Kuwait visa document
description: Kuwait only. Cross-checks the parsed agency identity against the Placement's actual Contractor and flags a mismatch (notify, never auto-reassigns).

summary: List Placements the caller's role can read
description: backend-issues #02: whitelisted replacement for the raw /api/resource/Placement fallback. Enforces the doctype's own permissions (Manager, Admin, System Manager, Contract Parser, Ticketer, Finance Manager, Clearance Officer, Complaint Manager, Communication Manager, and the six country+step roles).

summary: Get full Swagger specification JSON
description: Returns this full Swagger 2.0 / OpenAPI specification as a JSON object.

summary: Manually match an unmatched statement line to a batch
description: Escape hatch for lines the automatic matcher couldn't confidently resolve.

summary: Upload a bank statement CSV
description: Parses rows and runs the automatic line-to-batch matcher (matches by total amount).

summary: Export commission records as a binary .xlsx (CSV fallback)
description: Streams the file directly in the response (frappe.response['filecontent']), not a JSON body.

summary: New/Unresolved (with age)/Resolved counts
Approved transaction totals grouped by destination country
CVs created, medicals processed, clearances issued, embassies cleared, tickets booked, departures — for a date range
description: business-workflow-srs.md Part 8's exact list.

summary: Per-employee net expense + approval/rejection rate
Income/expense/commission/refund totals + outstanding/settled
description: Deliberately Admin-only, not Manager, unlike every other report here -- the financial-visibility wall from Step 8 applies to reporting too, not just the raw ledger.

summary: Recruitment funnel + SLA/turnaround dashboard data
description: Manager/Admin only. applicant_funnel/placement_funnel are current-state snapshot counts; conversion_rates and turnaround_days are computed from Process Event transitions within from_date/to_date; pending_overdue reuses get_placement_aging_report's thresholds plus unresolved-complaint and pending-transaction counts.

summary: List every Pending Applicant Transaction, oldest-first
description: So nothing sits forgotten waiting on Finance review.

summary: Placements approaching the ticket deadline, and critical ones not yet Departed
description: Two buckets, both sorted worst-first (highest priority): approaching_ticket_deadline (25-29 days since contract_signed_date) and critical_not_departed (30+ days). Distinct from the contract_age_watchdog push notification -- this is a pull/list view.

summary: get_daily_work_report's same breakdown, per individual staff member
description: Grouped by whoever actually did the work (CV Record.generated_by, Clearance Step.completed_by, Process Event.actor for placement-stage transitions).

summary: Get the ordered step definitions for a destination country's corridor
description: Data-driven -- adding a new corridor (e.g. a third country) is purely a Corridor Definition doc, no code change.
